M: <red>Thank you so much for organizing the annual company picnic, Jingdao.</red>
W: <green>Everybody seemed to enjoy it.</green>
M: <blue>Well, we deserved it after working so hard this year.</blue>
W: I agree.
M: The food was great by the way.
W: Especially the peach pie you made.
M: Would you mind sharing the recipe?

W: I'll send you a link to the webpage.

W: Tôi khuyên bạn nên xem nó đầu tiên.
